name: NoTear FPS Optimizer
description: Triet tieu xe hinh (Screen Tearing) khi Unlock FPS 240/360Hz bang DWM VBlank Phase-Lock va Smart Draw Divide v2.

enable-mod.name: Bat Anti-Tear Engine
enable-mod.description: Kich hoat bo xu ly chong xe hinh va on dinh frame pacing khi Unlock FPS.

draw-divide.name: Smart Draw Divide v2
draw-divide.description: Giu nguyen Physics/Input o 240-360Hz nhung chi xuat khung hinh khop voi tan so man hinh de xoa xe hinh va giam tai GPU.

auto-refresh-rate.name: Tu dong nhan tan so quet man hinh
auto-refresh-rate.description: Tu dong doc tan so quet thuc te cua man hinh (60Hz/75Hz/120Hz/144Hz) de khoa pha khung hinh.

render-fps.name: Target Render FPS (Khi tat Tu dong)
render-fps.description: So khung hinh xuat ra moi giay neu ban muon dat thu cong (Dat 60 cho man hinh 60Hz).

sync-mode.name: Che do VBlank Sync (1-3)
sync-mode.description: 1 = DWM VBlank Phase-Lock (Do tre thap nhat), 2 = Hardware Adaptive Tear-Control (Chong xe cung), 3 = DWM Composed Flush.

scanline-offset-us.name: Scanline Phase Offset (Microseconds)
scanline-offset-us.description: Tinh chinh vi tri diem lat khung hinh so voi VBlank (mac dinh -400 micro-giay de giau vet xe len mep tren).

true-borderless.name: True Borderless Flip Mode
true-borderless.description: Toi uu cua so khong vien tren Windows 11 de kich hoat bo chong xe hinh cua DWM.

gameplay-only.name: Chi ap dung khi dang trong man choi
gameplay-only.description: Chi bat Draw Divide khi o trong PlayLayer/Level, giu nguyen Menu va Editor.
